description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements a LogNode that filters logs to only pass along the message part, ignoring other metadata. Useful for displaying simplified log output such as on-screen logs.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters logs, passing only the message part to the next node in the pipeline.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides the LogNode method to filter log output, only passing the message.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
